source: APPP / MAFF-JICA — Rice Seed Production Manual (សៀវភៅមគ្គទេសក៍ផលិតកម្មពូជស្រូវ), 2014, Agricultural Productivity Promotion Project in West Tonle Sap, p.11
text: Selecting only full, well-filled, uniform seed grains before sowing matters because it drives a chain of downstream benefits: seed with a correct, uniform starting point germinates and establishes evenly; even germination produces healthy seedling growth; healthy uniform seedling growth leads to uniform flowering/heading; uniform heading produces a higher-quality, more uniform harvested product; and a higher-quality, more uniform seed product commands better value and profit when distributed or sold.
